setting: One locked-off Minecraft-style voxel shot inside a cozy enchanter's study at the top of a stone tower, framed close so the room's details and the view fill the picture. A huge arched window in the back wall, nearly floor to ceiling, looks out over a mountain lake with the sun low over the water. Packed bookshelves stand on both sides of the window, an enchanting table stands on a rug in front of it, a glass-block aquarium is built into the wall at the left and a stone fireplace is set in the wall at the right. No humans
weather: clear golden hour, the sun low over the lake
pet: a fox curled up asleep on a wool rug in front of the fireplace, with its ears and tail visible
props: an enchanting table (a dark obsidian base with diamond corners and a red cloth top) on the floor in front of the window, with nothing on it or floating above it: its book is animated afterwards
a brewing stand on a stone counter, its three glass bottles full of colored potion, with no steam or bubbles painted
a glass-block aquarium built into the left wall: clear blue water with kelp, seagrass, coral and sand, and no fish, axolotls or any other creatures in it (they are animated afterwards)
a stone fireplace with a low fire
a few candles and a hanging lantern
signature: the enchanting table's book floats above it, turning slowly and flipping its pages, while small glowing glyphs drift in from the bookshelves; blocky fish and an axolotl swim in the wall aquarium
signature_detail: a silverfish, the small silvery book bug, scurries in bursts along the stone floor at the foot of the bookshelves, stops to nibble at the corner of a book lying on the floor, and slips away behind the shelf (a sprite animated in code, never painted in the image)
stages: the floor at the foot of a bookshelf, with a closed book lying flat on it
the glass-block aquarium at the left
the mountain lake and open sky beyond the huge window
foreground: a thin strip of a patterned wool rug along the bottom of the frame, with a stack of books and a candle in the bottom left corner and a potted plant in the bottom right corner, and the fox curled up asleep on a cushion by the fireplace at the lower right, its ears and tail visible and fully in frame
midground: the enchanting table (a dark obsidian base with diamond corners and a red cloth top) on the rug a few steps in front of the window, with nothing on it or floating above it, packed bookshelves with hanging plants on both sides of the window, the glass-block aquarium built into the wall at the left, large and seen nearly face-on (clear blue water with kelp, seagrass, coral and sand, and no fish, axolotls or other creatures in it), a brewing stand on a stone counter beside the aquarium with three bottles of colored potion, the stone fireplace with a low fire at the right, lanterns hanging on chains and a few lit candles
background: through the huge arched window with clear glass, a wide view: a calm mountain lake with forested shores and a small island, layered snowy mountains, the low sun just above the far ridge laying a golden path across the water, and a big open sky with a few soft clouds (birds are animated afterwards, so none are painted)
light: low golden sunlight pours through the arch in long warm beams across the floor; the fireplace, the candles and the lantern add an amber glow; soft cool shadows in the corners
title_idea: 4K enchanter's tower at golden hour with calm Minecraft music and crackling fire, no ads (10 hours)
intro_lines: Welcome to the Enchanter's Tower, come watch the lake turn gold.
weather_why: his answer before the key art
composition: a small, intimate room framed close: the back wall with the huge window is only a few steps from the camera, so the floor shows only as a thin strip along the bottom of the frame, no more than a sixth of its height; the window fills the middle third of the frame from near the floor to near the ceiling, so the lake, the mountains and the sky take up a big part of the picture; the enchanting table stands just in front of the window, large and clearly readable, its top in the lower middle of the frame; the aquarium at the left and the fireplace with the fox at the right fill the sides; every part of the frame holds detail, with no large empty areas
